option_relations.rationale: Sporadic endometrial carcinoma does not imply a specific genetic mutation or syndrome
Lynch syndrome is associated with MSH6 gene mutations, which is consistent with the patient's genetic testing results
Endometrial carcinoma associated with Lynch syndrome is consistent with the patient's genetic testing results and family history
Stage IA endometrial cancer refers to the stage of the disease, not the underlying diagnosis or genetic association
